text: ok cool and then so my idea was i wanted to make a few head shapes, and then see if we can take the uv topology and can generate some more heads from some means of doing so. that way we can get a lot of head types from a few samples, but how many samples would we want
resolution: Design question, no code: advised on the head-variation-from-samples idea. Same-topology heads are blendable (each head = same vert order, so new heads are weighted mixes); recommended a neutral base + 6-8 single-trait EXAGGERATED extremes rather than N whole heads, because trait deltas compose multiplicatively while whole-head blends average toward mush. Region masks (jaw/skull/nose/ears from different samples) multiply variety further. Flagged the topology-freeze rule: duplicates must be move-verts-only — loop cut/solidify/delete breaks correspondence. Fits V2 seeded-variety ruling and V29 bake-as-assets (no runtime dynamic shapes).
